name: pupilla
description: Learns to predict your next prompt from the agent's last output, and offers up to 5 calibrated guesses to pick from

predictor.title: Predictor
predictor.description: Which model guesses your next prompt: fork (the session's own model over the cached transcript; best context) or a standalone model that sees only the memory and the last output

grader.title: Grader
grader.description: Model that scores the guesses against what you actually typed

reflector.title: Reflector
reflector.description: Model that periodically rewrites the rules and profile from accumulated misses
